scores.rationale: Placeholder-heavy: customer_id CUST0123..., location L123456789012, version_token ABC123XYZ..., note "Test payment for order", fingerprint abc123def, "SQ *Square Example". id alpha echoed, money adds up; created_at is 3 days before authorized_at.

Cafe POS sale with SQ *KITE CAFE and contactless reads well; fingerprint abcDEF1234567890 and bin 411111 are patterned. Tip 500 plus 4250 equals total 4750. created_at is one second after authorized_at, id does not echo kestrel.

Harbor Books, mira.chen and varied ids look real, but refund id "ilmfzweo" is junk and fee amount_money is {}. Note says online order with ECOMMERCE_API yet entry_method CONTACTLESS; refund_ids present with refunded_money 0.

Dana Whitfield, SQ *HARBOR GOODS, online pickup note and KEYED entry look production-like; only the empty fee amount_money {} is off. 12900+800=13700, 2500 refund matches refund_ids, updated_at follows the refund-era fee.

Harborlight coffee details are convincing, though $42.50 for "Cappuccino and pastry" is high. total_money 4250 ignores tip 500, refund_ids present with refunded_money 0, risk_evaluation created after capture.

SQ *HARBOR COFFEE with EMV is plausible, but card 411111/1111 and A1B2C3 are test-card tells. id echoes harbor, amounts agree across amount, approved and total, timestamps ordered and COMPLETED matches CAPTURED.

"Payment for order #123", buyer@example.com, refund "ref_001", receipt A1B2, "SQ *  LM" feel generic. created_at 20:41:27 is after authorized and captured, card status AUTHORIZED with captured_at, refund id with refunded 0.

Northgate Outfitters, m.reyes, camp stoves note and 18450+1250=19700 are very believable; fee amount_money {} is the tell. Note says online order but entry_method EMV; refund 4200 and timeline otherwise consistent.

note "Order notes here", customer@example.com, card 411111/1111, refund "azfodxnx" and "SQ *  LM" read as filler. 2850+150=3000 holds, but card status AUTHORIZED has captured_at and refund_ids sits with refunded_money 0.
